title: Cheesy Tagine Frittata
description: A flavorful, cheesy twist on the traditional North African tagine, this frittata is a hearty and satisfying breakfast or brunch option.
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté the bread cubes until lightly toasted.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs and zesty seasoning.
Pour egg mixture over toasted bread in the skillet.
Sprinkle shredded cheeses over the top.
Transfer skillet to the oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the cheese is melted and golden.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
